description: Two attack-release envelopes, each with its own gate input and its own modulation of the two stage times.

params.text: Attack time of the second envelope.
Attack time of the first envelope.
Release time of the first envelope.
Release time of the second envelope.
How much the first A and R jacks move the first envelope's two stage times.
How much the second A and R jacks move the second envelope's two stage times.
Combines the two gate inputs: up each envelope takes its own gate; middle the first fires while both are high and the second while either is; down the first fires while GATE1 is the higher.

inputs.text: Moves the second envelope's release time, by as much as the second MOD knob allows.
Moves the second envelope's attack time, by as much as the second MOD knob allows.
Moves the first envelope's attack time, by as much as the first MOD knob allows.
Moves the first envelope's release time, by as much as the first MOD knob allows.
The gate that fires the first envelope: it attacks while this is above 1.67V and releases below it.
The gate that fires the second envelope. With the switch up and nothing patched here, the second envelope follows GATE1 instead.

outputs.text: The second envelope as a voltage, rising while its gate is high and falling after it drops.
The first envelope as a voltage, rising while its gate is high and falling after it drops.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
The gate inputs are on the lower jack row, not the CV row; the four CV jacks only shift the stage times.
